title: Projected absolute Laplacian and conditional variance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$. For each coordinate $i$, projecting the pointwise absolute value of the coordinate Laplacian of $f$ onto all coordinates except $i$ gives the conditional variance of $f$ in coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
